answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 12382 Country: India Title: assalam o alaikum, janab mai abhi naukri (job) ke talash me hoon, mere dost factory me kaam karte hai. agar mai doston se unke factory mujhe kaam pe rakh lene ke liye unke BOSS se faryad karne ko kahun to ye jayaz hai ya nahi. Question: assalam o alaikum, janab mai abhi naukri (job) ke talash me hoon, mere dost factory me kaam karte hai. agar mai doston se unke factory mujhe kaam pe rakh lene ke liye unke BOSS se faryad karne ko kahun to ye jayaz hai ya nahi. Answer ID: 12382 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 689/689=M/1430) If the factory manufactures lawful items and you have the ability to work in the factory, there is nothing wrong to ask the friends working already in the company to recommend their boss to take you in his factory as employee. If by ?faryad? you mean anything else, please explain it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
